description: List workflow runs for a repository. Returns a response envelope {workflow_runs, page, limit, count, total_count, has_next}; total_count is present only when Forgejo reports it. has_next true means a further page may exist; re-issue the call with page incremented to fetch it.

event.description: Filter by event type (e.g. push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch)

status.description: Filter by status (e.g. waiting, running, success, failure, cancelled)

name: list_workflow_runs
